## Decision

S0-PARITY-CORPUS runs in wave 0, before the S1-SCHEMA tracer bullet, recording full hook stdin payloads plus observed exit codes from the legacy path as committed fixture data.

## Rationale

AC-3 requires replaying identical inputs against old and new. Once legacy code is deleted at S6-CUTOVER the legacy verdicts are unrecoverable, so the corpus must be recorded while the old path still runs. Storing full payloads rather than summaries lets the parity suite execute both surfaces instead of asserting on source text.

## Alternatives Considered

- Capture the corpus after the new implementation lands, deriving expected verdicts from the spec
- Skip recorded corpus and hand-write parity expectations from PACING-R-001..011 prose
